images.name: avatar-you.png
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-avatar.
Asset type: player avatar portrait, avatar-you.png. It will be shown small (about 40 to 56 pixels) inside a circle, so it must read at a glance.
Output: PNG, exactly 1024x1024 pixels, square.

STYLE:
Hand-painted gouache illustration with confident, visible brushstrokes and slightly rough paper grain, in the same style as a set of storybook creature cards. Flat layered planes of color, bold simple silhouette, one soft light source from the upper left, gold (#f6cf6a) rim light on the top edges. Shapes are simplified and graphic, not photoreal. Palette for this avatar: warm gold (#f6cf6a), honey amber (#d9a441), deep navy (#1a2440), cream (#f6ead2).

SUBJECT:
A friendly, curious young owl wearing a small navy hooded cloak trimmed in gold. Big round amber eyes, a calm, encouraging half-smile look. Soft cream face feathers, honey-amber body feathers. Feels like a kind guide sitting beside you.

COMPOSITION:
Head and shoulders only, facing three-quarters toward the viewer, centered so the face sits in the middle of the frame with even margin all around (a circle crop must not cut the head or ears). The face takes up about 45% of the frame. Big, clear shapes; no small details that vanish when tiny.

BACKGROUND:
A flat, deep navy (#1a2440) background with a soft warm gold glow behind the head. Plain and simple so the character pops. No scenery.

AVOID:
photorealism, 3D render look, glossy plastic shading, airbrushed smooth gradients, HDR glow, text, letters, logos, frames, borders, watermarks, signatures, extra limbs, warped anatomy, scary or aggressive expression, human figures.
